aesthetic: antique parchment background with subtle grain
clean TCG UI language with a large art window
print-ready color grading, restrained contrast, no neon saturation
negative: no text outside the card border

geometry.frame: identical across all type and rarity combinations

LOT.spec_boundary: The received Lot Reward section ended after 'trim'. Only the declared reward field and frame geometry are represented; no omitted reward content or geometry is inferred.

NOUN.prompt: TYPE is exactly NOUN; apply only the NOUN label/icon treatment.

VERB.prompt: TYPE is exactly VERB; apply only the VERB label/icon treatment.

ADJECTIVE.prompt: TYPE is exactly ADJECTIVE; apply only the ADJECTIVE label/icon treatment.

NAME.prompt: TYPE is exactly NAME; apply only the NAME label/icon treatment.

TITLE.prompt: TYPE is exactly TITLE; apply only the TITLE label/icon treatment.

COMMON.prompt: RARITY is exactly COMMON followed by one white diamond; no activation cost.

UNCOMMON.prompt: RARITY is exactly UNCOMMON followed by one green diamond; no activation cost.

RARE.prompt: RARITY is exactly RARE followed by one gold diamond; show +🂠 below it.

GLORIOUS.prompt: RARITY is exactly GLORIOUS followed by one orange diamond; show +🂠🂠 below it.
